finalText:
**Migrated 12 files, 36 call sites, to `db.execute({ sql, params })`.** All of `packages/` now parses clean under `node --check`. No `db.query` left there.

One left on purpose: [vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9) has 2 calls. Its header says do not edit, since upgrades overwrite it. That needs an upstream fix or a wrapper.

I left `cache.query` alone. Different object, not part of this.
